summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026 disclosing an update to its corporate governance policies, including a commitment to gender diversity targets for future annual meetings. The filing notes a transaction from early 2026 has recently terminated, but provides no deal terms, sides, or financial details. This is a routine governance policy update, not a special-situation event; the reference to a terminated transaction is incidental and lacks materiality here.
